description: Source code for managing feature flags in the Mattermost platform, including setup, synchronization, and update mechanisms.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Service class responsible for platform operations, including feature flag management.

methods.name: SetupFeatureFlags
methods.description: Initializes feature flag synchronization on startup or cluster leadership change.

methods.name: updateFeatureFlagValuesFromManagement
methods.description: Fetches and applies updated feature flag values from the management service.

methods.name: startFeatureFlagUpdateJob
methods.description: Starts the background job to periodically synchronize feature flags.

methods.name: StopFeatureFlagUpdateJob
methods.description: Stops the background feature flag synchronization job.
